comparison.objective: Lower a ratchet-held load through an intermediate hold and onto a rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Carry load through a crank while releasing and re-engaging a pawl.
comparison.success_condition: Intermediate hands-off hold followed by controlled lowering to the rest; numeric rubric is absent.
comparison.reason: Load transfer through a ratchet is different from setting a screw stop and locking its calibration.
